name: Vivint
notes: Researched from public support.vivint.com articles only (never signed in to Account Center). Monthly monitoring is invoiced one month in advance. Account Center takes one-time payments (Make a Payment, enter amount and payment method, Continue) and stores credit cards or bank accounts under Billing > Settings > Payment methods, where a checkbox marks a method for AutoPay. Only the account's primary email address can make payments or see billing. Opting out of automatic payments is not available online: the FAQ says to contact Customer Solutions by chat; modelled as unsupported online (the limitation answer uses the catalog customer-service phone). Paper statements cost $1 each (not modelled as an engine fee; noted in help). Billing date can be set to any day 1-31 by asking Customer Solutions (not modelled). Cancellation is by phone only at 1-800-678-2635 and may carry an early termination fee per the service agreement; equipment financing through Fortiva (or legacy Citizens Pay) is a separate bill that is not modelled. A $99 fee applies to service visits after the first 120 days (information only). Guest payment is not documented, so it is left at the family default. Plan prices are not published, so the plan page keeps the family's synthetic plans.

autopay_cancel.note: Automatic payments cannot be turned off online. Contact Vivint Customer Solutions by chat (bubble at the bottom right of the support site) or by phone to opt out.

cancel_service.note: Call Vivint Customer Service at 1-800-678-2635 to cancel. Early termination or other fees in your service agreement may apply.

help.title: Make a payment
paragraphs: Log in to Account Center with the account's primary email address; other logins cannot make payments. Select Make a Payment, enter the amount and the payment method, and select Continue.
If service was shut off for non-payment, app access usually comes back the day after the payment processes, but it can take up to 48 hours.
Payments larger than the bill are applied to future bills. To mail a payment, send it to Vivint Inc., 62992 Collection Drive, Chicago, IL 60693-0629.
steps: Enter the amount and choose a payment method.

help.title: Add a payment method and AutoPay
paragraphs: In Account Center choose Billing in the left menu, scroll to Settings and choose Payment methods. Select Add New Account, enter the card or bank details, and tick the box if the method should be used for AutoPay, then select Add Account.
Vivint encourages automatic, paperless billing. With AutoPay your payment is drawn on your billing date.
Opting out of automatic payments is not available online; contact Customer Solutions through chat.
steps: Select Add New Account and enter the details.
Tick the AutoPay box and select Add Account.

help.title: Billing and transaction history
paragraphs: Your current amount due is on the Account Center welcome page. Choose Billing, then Billing History, and use the arrow to download a statement.
Choose Transaction History to see your payments and open the arrow for details.
steps: Select Billing History or Transaction History.

help.title: Billing FAQs
paragraphs: Monthly monitoring is invoiced one month in advance, which is why the bill is due before the period ends.
Vivint charges $1 for each paper statement. Equipment financing through Fortiva (or older Citizens Pay loans) is billed separately by that lender.

You can pick any billing date from the 1st to the 31st by asking Customer Solutions. On AutoPay that is the draft date; otherwise it is your due date. Changing it mid-cycle adds a prorated adjustment to the next bill.
After the first 120 days, service visits cost $99 each, with a 60-day guarantee if the same issue comes back.

help.title: Cancellation policy
paragraphs: To cancel Vivint services, call Customer Service at 1-800-678-2635. Early termination or other fees from your service agreement may apply; the agreement is in the Documents section of Account Center.
Any equipment financing balance must still be paid under that financing agreement.

For a death, bankruptcy, move to assisted living or similar circumstance, call the same number; an Exceptions Review Team reviews each case with documentation. Customers 65 or older cancelling because of a medical condition or a move to a care facility may avoid the early termination fee.

extra.intent: Using Vivint's help pages, find out how much Vivint charges for each paper statement. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Vivint charges $1 for each paper statement.

extra.intent: Your Vivint system was installed a year ago and a sensor stopped working. Using Vivint's help pages, find out what a service visit costs. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
